text: Welcome, let's start the meeting. Today's question is what Acme should prioritize this week. I will ask each of you for your view.
From the code side, the most urgent task is to finish the booking flow. An open bug in the schedule sync breaks the teachers' calendar.
I see a chance on social media. Short videos of live classes get the best reach, and we have not posted one this week.
Before we launch anything, we need tests for card payments. Today nothing covers that path, and it is where a failure hurts most.
Looking at the market, two competitors just released discounted yearly plans. We should review our prices before the gap shows.
